The Prophet frowned and turned away.
It was because a blind man came to him and interrupted.
Allah says: How do you know? Maybe he would become better in his heart.
Or maybe he would listen and it would help him.
As for the one who thinks he does not need anything.
You give him your attention.
You are not to blame if he does not become good.
But as for the one who came to you wanting to learn.
And he fears Allah.
You are not paying attention to him.
No! These verses are a reminder.
Whoever wants to, can remember it.
It is written on honored pages.
They are high and clean.
They are in the hands of angel writers.
They are kind and good.
Shame on man! He does not say thank you!
What did Allah make him from?
From a tiny drop He made him and planned his life.
Then He made the way easy for him.
Then He makes him die and puts him in a grave.
Then when He wants, He will bring him back to life.
No! Man has not done what Allah told him to do.
Let man look at his food.
We poured down water in lots of rain.
Then We split open the earth.
And made grain grow in it.
And grapes and vegetables.
And olives and date trees.
And thick gardens.
And fruit and grass.
All of this is for you and your animals to enjoy.
But when the loudest blast comes.
On that Day a person will run from his brother.
And his mother and his father.
And his wife and his children.
Each person that Day will be busy with his own problem.
Some faces that Day will be bright.
They will be smiling and happy.
Other faces that Day will be covered with dust.
Darkness will cover them.
They are the ones who said no to Allah and did wrong.
